comparator.sourceNotes: Groningen confirms the core courses, Living Lab, minor and capstone. The rules for choosing the remaining electives for students who entered in September 2026 still need confirmation.
components: Research internship with a partner organisation. Foundation and skills courses precede the internship.
The minor semester can include an exchange, an internship or courses from another faculty.
The 10 EC capstone combines a supervised thesis with a portfolio on personal and social responsibility.

audience.programmeDescription: Global Responsibility and Leadership at Campus Fryslân studies sustainability, politics, behaviour and global health. Students develop research skills and use them in a project with a partner organisation.
